candidate_policy: evaluate the exact frozen P5A profile without retuning

measurements.edge_frequency: presampled edge MTF, reported only through physical sample Nyquist
report: halo width at one-percent edge span

severe_vetoes: bright or dark contour ringing visible as a secondary edge
colour fringing caused by channel-dependent adjacency

negative_controls: zero adjacency gain must remove adjacency halo exactly
frequency reporting above physical sample Nyquist must be rejected
reversing scanner MTF and density interpretation must remain distinguishable
forbidden_fallbacks: retune P5A gains, sigmas, sensitometry or thresholds after confirmatory output
hard clip density or scan-linear output
hide undershoot by reporting overshoot alone
promote from a visually pleasant contact sheet when an automatic severe-halo gate fails
claim measured film, stock, process or scanner MTF

branch_rule.pass: retain the exact P5A profile as a development spatial candidate and proceed to held-out synthetic structure/OOD checks
branch_rule.fail: close the exact failing adjacency profile, retain independently safe spatial stages, and freeze a new bounded adjacency family only under a separate candidate contract
